meta.name: azure-resource-visualizer
meta.description: Analyze Azure resource groups and generate detailed Mermaid architecture diagrams showing the relationships between individual resources. Use this skill when the user asks for a diagram of their Azure resources or help in understanding how the resources relate to each other.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Azure 资源组并生成架构图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理 Azure 资源时想直观理解资源间关系
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Azure resource groups and generate architecture diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Azure resources and want to visualize their relationships

howto.what: 当用户请求分析Azure资源组时，Claude会扫描指定资源组，识别所有资源及其配置和依赖关系，然后生成详细的Mermaid架构图，并输出包含图表的Markdown文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看Azure资源图表，或请求帮助理解资源间的关系时触发。如果未指定资源组，Claude会先列出所有资源组供用户选择。

say.note: Claude会分析该资源组并生成图

say.text: 展示我资源组里资源的关系

howto.what_en: When asked to analyze an Azure resource group, Claude scans the specified group, identifies all resources with their configurations and dependencies, generates a detailed Mermaid architecture diagram, and outputs a Markdown document with the diagram.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a diagram of Azure resources or help understanding resource relationships. If no resource group is specified, Claude lists available groups for selection.

say_en.note: Claude lists resource groups for selection
Claude analyzes that group and generates diagram

say_en.text: Show relationships among resources in my group
say_en.note: Claude maps relationships and draws diagram
